name: swordweave-companion
description: Look up SwordWeave rules, plan character builds, and bring your saved characters into your tabletop RPG chat.

interface.longDescription: Look up SwordWeave rules with links to the Play Guide. Explore catalogue pieces, preview a starter build or advancement, read the characters available to your linked SwordWeave account, and open their printable sheets and monster companions. Use SwordWeave to save changes to a character.
defaultPrompt: What do I need to choose for my first SwordWeave character?
Find three domains for a storm mage and explain what each covers.
List my SwordWeave characters so I can open a character sheet.

positive.description: Find the starting rules in the Play Guide.
positive.prompt: What do I need to choose for my first SwordWeave character? Cite the Play Guide.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains Verb tier, Domain, Range, and Dice type, gives the free Touch and d4 baseline where applicable, and links to the first-character guide.

positive.description: Find starting verb-tier primitives by category.
positive.prompt: Find Verb Access Tier III in SwordWeave's starting verb tiers. Show the catalogue link.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the Verb Tier category and returns Verb Access Tier III and its catalogue link.

positive.description: Preview a starter character using catalogue entries.
positive.prompt: Preview a level-one SwordWeave character using Verb Access Tier III, Domain Access Tier I, Touch Range, and Heavy Die Block (1d8). Show my starting build costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up four exact catalogue pins, previews 20 of 25 Build Units spent with 5 remaining, and leaves the linked account's saved character list unchanged.

positive.description: Open a saved character's standard sheet PDF.
positive.prompt: Find Gale Reed in my SwordWeave characters and give me the standard character sheet PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the fictional review character and returns a same-origin link to the standard printable sheet. The link downloads the character sheet in the signed-in SwordWeave browser.

positive.description: Open a saved character's available monster companions.
positive.prompt: Which monster companions can I see on Gale Reed's sheet? Give me the play sheet and Bestiary links that are available.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the fictional character's available companions and links based on the review account's character and Bestiary access.

negative.prompt: Get the PDF for the private SwordWeave sheet linked in the reviewer instructions. It belongs to a different account and has not been shared with me.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin returns no sheet data or download link. A direct link to the private sheet also requires access.

negative.description: Keep real character changes on SwordWeave.
negative.prompt: Set Gale Reed's current Vitality to 1 and save it in SwordWeave now.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin can explain how to change Vitality on the sheet. There is no write tool in this release and the stored value remains unchanged.

negative.prompt: Make a level-one character preview with d8 and Touch and skip both Verb tier and Domain. Tell me if I can start using that build.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that a starting build needs eligible Verb tier and Domain access and asks for the missing choices.

publication.release_notes: Initial release for rules and catalogue lookup, character build previews, saved-sheet access, and links to monster companions and character PDFs.
